title: Encode anti-slop design build-workflow patterns into the design-power pack guidance
description:
Capture the vendor-neutral process patterns from the reference video (github.com/bradautomates/claude-video's subject creator; source: YouTube 7FU98O0JLHs, "defeat AI slop in 3 steps") into the design-power pack's design guidance. This is PURE internal authoring — no third-party code, no supply-chain trust. Adopting the actual external tools (Impeccable, Taste Skill, Higgsfield MCP, 21st.dev) is tracked separately and is human-gated (the human chose TRACKED installs, not assimilation).

Encode these patterns as design guidance (a references doc under the design-power skill guidance, and/or pipeline-step notes — do not bloat SKILL.md frontmatter):
1. Taste/inspiration step: curate a reference library (Dribbble/Pinterest/X), grouped by design type with design vocabulary + reusable image-prompt/brief per item; feed as the foundation instead of one-shotting.
2. Four-part prompt template: (a) aesthetic/design family, (b) reference image(s) from the taste library (feel, not copy), (c) intent (what/why, target audience, desired user action), (d) guardrails (always/never — e.g. never purple gradients, never Inter font, no 3D SaaS blobs).
3. Wide-net-then-narrow build sequence: generate ~5 versions in 5 distinct styles side-by-side → pick 1 → 3 body variants → pick 1 → tweak; compare on one screen rather than serial one-shots.
4. Assets-last ordering: nail the hero image (generate several, pick, then color variants) before fine typography; then transitions/motion/"weight"/reveal distance.
5. Live tweaks-bar pattern: add a Claude-Design-style tweak bar to the dev server (font family/size, accent colors, motion, reveal distance) for fast visual iteration instead of prompt-and-pray.
6. Anti-slop lens: the 7 axes (typography, color, spatial, responsiveness, interaction, motion, UX writing) as a review checklist; reference that a fuller slop-pattern catalogue exists upstream.

Keep it vendor-neutral (patterns, not tool ads). Cross-reference the tracked-tool adoption ticket once it exists. verification_tier uat-only: this is guidance/docs, verified by reading the authored guidance against these six points.
acceptance_criteria: A design build-workflow guidance doc is added under the design-power pack's skill guidance (references/ or equivalent), not crammed into SKILL.md frontmatter

The doc covers all six patterns: taste/inspiration library, the four-part prompt template, wide-net-then-narrow build sequence, assets-last ordering, live tweaks-bar, and the 7-axis anti-slop review lens
Guidance is vendor-neutral (describes patterns/process, does not hard-depend on any specific third-party tool)
It cross-references (by ticket key or descriptor resource) the separately-tracked external-tool adoption once that lands
UAT: read the authored guidance and confirm each of the six patterns is present and actionable
